# flashblade_workload (Data Source)

Reads an existing FlashBlade workload by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "flashblade_workload" "example" {
  name = "my-workload"
}

output "workload_id" {
  value = data.flashblade_workload.example.id
}

output "workload_status" {
  value = data.flashblade_workload.example.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the workload to look up.

### Read-Only

- `context` (Attributes) The fleet context that owns this workload (read-only, API-managed). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--context))
- `created` (Number) The workload creation time, measured in milliseconds since the UNIX epoch.
- `destroyed` (Boolean) True if the workload has been soft-deleted and is pending eradication.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the workload.
- `preset_name` (String) The name of the preset this workload was deployed from.
- `status` (String) The workload status (e.g. creating, ready, destroying, destroyed, eradicating, recovering).
- `status_details` (List of String) Additional information about the workload status.
- `time_remaining` (Number) Time remaining in milliseconds before the destroyed workload is permanently eradicated.

<a id="nestedatt--context"></a>
### Nested Schema for `context`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The context unique identifier.
- `name` (String) The context name.
